{{Quote|Liam, the shades.|Yoda|<ref name="Episode II" />}}
'''Liam''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi youngling]] who [[Jedi training|trained]] in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]] during the [[Separatist Crisis]]. He was trained by [[Yoda]], the [[Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order]].

==Biography==
Liam was a [[Jedi Initiate|youngling]] who became part of the [[Jedi Order]] some [[time]] prior to the [[Clone Wars]]. During the [[Separatist Crisis]], he was part of the [[Bear Clan]],<ref name="Bear Clan DB" /> a class of [[youngling]]s [[Jedi training|trained]] by [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]]. During a session in which the younglings trained to use a [[lightsaber]], [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] inquired to Yoda regarding the location of the [[planet]] [[Kamino]], which he could not find in the [[Jedi Archives]]. Kenobi displayed a map of [[the galaxy]] in the training room, and Yoda requested that Liam lower the shades. He did so, and the room darkened so the map could be viewed.<ref name="Episode II" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Liam appeared in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="Episode II" /> Their name is a reference to actor [[Liam Neeson]], who portrayed the character of [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Episode II commentary">{{Film|II}} DVD commentary</ref>
